title: Life/City Sim + Visual Novel + AI Roleplay | PC Game Work in Progress
author: Wizirdi
selftext:
I just wanted to show a project I've been working on. I've been a gamedev for about 20+ years and started on this new untitled project that blends ai roleplay, visual novels and life simulation.

It's pretty feature rich, the game is tracking the states like what the characters are wearing, their inventory, stats, relationships, mood, needs, desires, etc...

I'm working on the logic for the simulation of the city the player will be living in. Every interaction/rp chat you have will matter. If you go to the park, and pick a fight with a stranger in the ai chat, he will remember that. If, later on in the game, you try to get a job somewhere and that stranger turns out to be the boss, he will remember the interaction and will respond accordingly.

The characters and locations are all made in such a way that I could attach an editor, where players can make their own city with locations and characters and share them.

[The game keeps track of outfits and locations for the ai](https://preview.redd.it/2qyloymyj0lh1.png?width=1272&format=png&auto=webp&s=952b7460d5c4c5e755be308dad6abc54d50930df)

[The game keeps track of all the items within the scene. Also, it supports up to 4 characters](https://preview.redd.it/9f1hhot0l0lh1.png?width=1273&format=png&auto=webp&s=ad818f319f85dec40ea7213af589e01b05a25d92)

[Change your outfit!](https://preview.redd.it/3vf9y3x8l0lh1.png?width=1275&format=png&auto=webp&s=77aded0ed7cb5f2c48cd3d75ba612eb7a0e425ed)

I'd love to hear your suggestions, feedback, etc!
